status: PROPOSED (2026-10-21): the rules every Stage-2 training, validation or calibration pool must pass before a target is generated for it. Applied by scripts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/isolation_check.py; nothing here edits or rebuilds a registered evaluation set.

protected.eval_set: the registry's default_formal_measurement (eval-set-1, frozen identity 2), read through scripts/shared/eval_sets.py so a modified set is refused before any overlap is computed
protected.in_sample_roles: stage3_legacy_150: overlap is REPORTED, never refused (it is made of training prompts by definition)

rules.requirement: no training item shares a prompt key or a content_sha256 with any held-out unit
no training prompt is a near-copy of a held-out prompt: word 13-gram containment below 0.5
rules.mechanism: aadistill.evaluation.isolation.ngram_containment against one index per held-out unit (prompt_text), so every flag names the unit it copies
rules._max_document_frequency: an n-gram found in more than 5 prompts of one held-out unit is that unit's template, not content; it is dropped from that unit's index
rules.on_violation: refuse the flagged items; items sharing any 13-gram are counted and listed for review
rules.why: exact keys miss a reworded or re-formatted copy; public math and QA training sets are known to carry near-copies of their test splits

rules.requirement: no training item comes from a rule family that any fluid evaluation item uses (key generator_id/family_id, and family_id alone)
no training item comes from an evaluation-only generator, or from any other generator whose task type is one of theirs

eval_only_task_types.counterfactual_arith: arithmetic under a stated counterfactual redefinition of operators or numerals
eval_only_task_types.graph_paths: path finding / reachability over a described graph

rules.mechanism: generator id check, plus a declared task_type on every external or new procedural family, reviewed by hand once per family and recorded in the source catalogue
rules.why: the five evaluation-only generators are what makes part of fluid_reasoning_720 an UNSEEN-FORMAT measurement; a training family of the same task type from another generator would quietly turn it into a seen-format one

rules.requirement: a training item from one of the ten generators eval-set-1 shares with Stage-0 calibration must come from that generator's calibration-split families (registry.family_split) under the v2 roster, with a seed in the training range below
rules.roster: registry.GENERATORS_V2 (v2 keeps v1 family ids, so the split is unchanged)
rules.reported_as: generator_exposure = shared: evaluation on those generators' held-out families measures unseen-RULE transfer in a SEEN format, and is reported separately from the evaluation-only generators (unseen format)

rules.requirement: an item from an external dataset comes from a split the source catalogue declares trainable; a split any eval-set-1 unit was drawn from is never trainable
no official ARC-AGI evaluation task, solution, trajectory or trivial derivative in any pool (AGENTS.md P10.2); ARC-AGI training-set derivatives only after a separate maintainer decision
overlap with the in-sample component, with the Stage-0 calibration task sets and with the historical training corpora is reported
